L0·N2466unmasked layer
Fires on the sub-word continuation token that follows an "M/m" fragment in a split word (e.g. "M|ids", "m|inding", "MEM|ORIES", "M|akers", "m|u"), i.e. it is tracking the M-prefix word-piece boundary rather than any meaning; it is strongly suppressed when the M-piece is "Mot/MOT" (motivated, MOT).
